nodes.author: SankalpaHospit
nodes.text:
What is #hmpvvirus ?
HMPV stands for Human Metapneumovirus
- A contagious respiratory virus affecting lungs & airways.
- It was first discovered in 2001, Netherlands, now recognized globally.
- Severe in children, elderly, and those with      weak immunity. https://t.co/DMuVK2Zhkp

nodes.author: SankalpaHospit
nodes.text:
#Symptoms of HMPV Infection:
- Runny/stuffy nose
- Persistent cough
- Fever & fatigue
- Shortness of breath or wheezing
- Severe cases: Pneumonia or bronchitis

#HMPVinlndia #HMPVoutbreak https://t.co/aaNcUrSHea

nodes.author: SankalpaHospit
nodes.text:
How it Spreads: Mode of Transmission:
- Respiratory droplets (coughing/sneezing)
- Touching contaminated surfaces
- Close contact with infected individuals

#HMPVCase #HMPVoutbreak https://t.co/aLxIYfxr6l

nodes.author: SankalpaHospit
nodes.text:
Prevention Tips: Stay Safe from HMPV:
- Wash hands often with soap.
- Avoid close contact with sick individuals.
- Disinfect surfaces regularly.
- Wear a mask in crowded places.
#HMPVVirusInIndia #socialdistance https://t.co/fifwUWG3i0

Treatment: Managing HMPV Infection:
- Rest & stay hydrated.
- Use OTC meds for fever/pain.
- Seek medical help for severe symptoms like      difficulty breathing.

#HMPVtreatment https://t.co/tiUtKoPliR
